scope: 42 deterministic Flutter state captures only; no native certification, build, device action, product edit or golden promotion.
limits: All captures are English at text scale 1.0. Pseudolocalization and large-text review are outside this task.
Geometry/semantics are fixture exports; 48px verification is limited to recorded controls and does not certify native controls.
Missing-state notes describe this 42-capture set only, not all repository evidence.
No test suite or application was run during review.

issues.summary: Read failure is simultaneously presented as an empty library.
issues.detail: The banner says the operation failed and offers Retry, while the results area asserts Your library is empty and offers Manage sources. A failed read does not establish emptiness. Keep a distinct read-error result state, or retain previously known rows.
issues.resolution: Both failed-read captures now present Library unavailable with Retry and no assertion of an empty library.

issues.summary: Recovered enabled Start action is nearly illegible and looks disabled in this PNG.
issues.detail: The screenshot shows dark Start text on the dark inactive-looking button fill, whereas semantics marks Start enabled and tap-capable. The corresponding head-none screenshot has the expected coral fill. This is likely a transition captured before its paint has settled; capture the settled recovered state, and verify transition contrast if this frame can occur in production.
issues.resolution: Recovered Start has coral enabled fill and enabled/tap semantics; callback-derived disabled state and keyed tween reset prevent the observed stale fill.

issues.summary: Active source operation still exposes an enabled Scan action.
issues.detail: Both PNG and semantics present Scan as enabled while an existing operation is queued, reading, scanning, cancelling, or committing. Disable/hide duplicate start while the operation is active; the current fixture explicitly asserts Scan is operable in these states. Cancel availability itself is appropriately absent during cancelling/committing.
issues.resolution: All six captured active phases disable Scan in paint and semantics. Source code also includes ingesting; observation remains enabled.

issues.summary: Narrow results summary abuts the Two-player label.
issues.detail: At 600x540 the line reads visually as 1 games · swipe to b...Two-player: the truncated summary ends directly against the filter label. Preserve a visible gap or hide the secondary swipe hint at this width. Four categories and toolbar actions remain reachable.
issues.resolution: A fixed 8 px gap separates summary/ellipsis from Two-player. Narrow safe-area state and all 24 hall/search matrix PNGs reopened.

missingSpecStates.detail: This set does not demonstrate a successfully decoded cover versus a failed-cover fallback, a visible search input/clear/close state, or populated search results. The hall-search state renders empty results with the search input closed.

No builtin-source protected row, completed cancellation, failed targeted reauthorization with the original row retained, failed removal with the row retained, or successful removal/addition result is pictured. Picker cancellation and removal confirmation are present.

No expanded custom-axis chooser, audio-focus chooser, reset completion result, applied language-change result, or About version/build/absent-link state is included. The locked preset, reset confirmation, failed audio write and language chooser are present.

No long license scroll position, narrow-window dialog, keyboard-visible/back-order state, or terminal read-retry recovery for every failure family is included. Wide dialogs and short license text are readable.
These are individual state captures; they do not establish start/middle/end animation timing, interruption handling, success-message lifetime, or reduced-motion behavior.
